content.line: And I wondered if they were happy and content
stanza: I walked out in a field, the grass was high
It brushed against my legs
I just stood and looked out at the open space
And a farmhouse out aways
And I wondered about the people who lived in it
And I wondered if they were happy and content
Were there children and a man and a wife?
Did she love him and take her hair down at night?

content.line: You could say I was content
stanza: Me, I wasn't even trying
You could say I was content
She went through my life like lightning
Blew out the other end
Stalin wasn't stallin'
When he told the beast of Berlin
That they'd never rest contented
Till they had driven him from the land
So he called the Yanks and English
And proceeded to extinguish
The Führer and its vermin
This is how it all began
